name: Jinseok Lee
intro: I study how interfaces, microstructure, and deformation shape fluid flow and transport.

research.title: Diffusion in crowded environments
research.question: How does the space accessible to a tracer govern its motion?
research.text: I combine particle-tracking experiments, simulations, and statistical modeling to connect tracer diffusion with the geometry of crowded soft materials. Our work identifies accessible pore size as a key descriptor of transport, even when distinct microstructures produce similar mean-squared displacements.

research.title: Flow through deformable particle packings
research.question: How does a changing particle structure reshape the flow through it?
research.text: I investigate the coupling between fluid flow and deformation in confined hydrogel particle packings. By comparing particles of different stiffness and soft–rigid mixtures, I examine how deformation and rearrangement influence pressure drop, permeability, and clogging.
